connections.label: Sony VISCA over UDP
setupNotes: Enable LAN control before starting. Reply source port can differ from target port.
Close the standalone probe before OBS uses the listening port.
Port 52380 is for network discovery/configuration, not this control transport.

notes: Profile owns UDP framing, fixed target/listening ports, forced address 1, reset setup time, inter-request gap, reply timeout and command/range data. Camera Selection contains installation choices only.

Zoom/STOP/readback confirmed in the v0.1.9 plugin by the maintainer. Added pan/tilt, Home, absolute zoom, focus, preset, power, white-balance, backlight and exposure commands require incremental hardware testing.
255 presets over IP is maintainer-reported. SimpleCam physical presets 1..255 encode VISCA memory indexes 0..254. High-index store/recall has not been tested; do not infer it from profile validation.
No startup power changes, preset erase or identification dependency. Clear in SimpleCam only clears labels. Preset transition speed is not enabled.
